# MYTHRIL

> High-velocity Neo-Brutalist Sprint Kanban & Project Management dashboard.

## Overview
MYTHRIL is a modern developer-centric sprint management and Kanban application built with Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL. It delivers an authentic Neo-Brutalist design language (3px solid borders, hard drop shadows, high contrast palettes, and zero fluff) combined with robust engineering features.

## Key Capabilities
- **Kanban Workflow**: Drag-and-drop issue cards, keyboard moves, subtask checklist items, and real-time status updates.
- **In-Place Stage Management**: Reorder columns (`[←]`, `[→]`), create custom stages (`+ ADD COLUMN`), and configure labels/colors/kinds directly on the dashboard (`/`) without navigating away to an admin console.
- **Interactive Sprint Settings**: Configure sprint duration presets (1-4 weeks), custom start and end date pickers, sprint goals, and real-time sprint health metrics (open issues, high-severity bugs, completion progress).
- **Multi-Project System**: Global active project state persistence in `localStorage` across page transitions (`/`, `/admin`, `/profile`) and full browser reloads.
- **Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)**: Admin dashboard with user approval requests, password resets, member assignment rosters, and 2-step cascade safety warnings.
- **Form & Input Experience**: Accessible custom select dropdowns, granular per-field validation without premature error banners on keyboard navigation, and instant dark/light mode toggle.

## Tech Stack
- Frontend: Next.js 15 (App Router), React 19, Vanilla CSS Design System
- Backend: Next.js Route Handlers, Node.js crypto authentication (scrypt + HMAC session cookies)
- Database: PostgreSQL (compatible with Supabase Transaction Pooler and SSL require mode)
- Testing: Vitest unit test suite (60+ tests) and PostgreSQL database integration tests

## Routes
- `/`: Main interactive Kanban board, sprint banner, and in-place column controls
- `/login`: Session authentication with remember-me support
- `/register`: User onboarding with administrative approval request flow
- `/profile`: User profile management, password change, and custom avatar upload
- `/admin`: Administrative panel for user approvals, project rosters, and global column defaults
